question: The name of the active volcano in India is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barren island**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Barren Island is home to India's **only active volcano**, located in the **Andaman Sea.**
 
• It lies about **135 km northeast of Port Blair** in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• It has experienced several eruptions since the **first recorded one in 1787**, with the most recent eruptions occurring in the 21st century.
 
• Despite being volcanic, the surrounding waters are popular for scuba diving due to rich marine biodiversity and unique geological formations.
 
• The island is uninhabited by humans, though some flora and fauna, like birds, bats, and rodents, exist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neill island** 

 
 
• Neil Island is part of the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**, situated 36 km northeast of Port Blair.
 
• Known for its fertile soil, it is referred to as the "**vegetable bowl" **of the Andamans due to its extensive agriculture.
 
• The island is a popular tourist destination, famous for its coral reefs, clear waters, and tranquil beaches like **Bharatpur, Laxmanpur, and Sitapur.**
 
 
 
• **Ross Island**
 
 
• Ross Island served as the administrative **headquarters of the British **in the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands from 1858 to 1941.**
 
• It was abandoned after an earthquake in 1941 and subsequent Japanese invasion during **World War II.**
 
• The island now attracts tourists with its ruins of British-era buildings, including a church, bakery, and cemetery, and is home to wildlife like deer and peacocks.
 
 
 
• **Sentinel Island**
 
 
• North Sentinel Island is home to the Sentinelese,** one of the world's last uncontacted indigenous tribes**, known for resisting outside contact.
 
• The Indian government has declared the island off-limits to outsiders, ensuring the tribe's isolation for their protection and cultural preservation.
 
• Located in the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands,** North Sentinel Island is surrounded by shallow reefs, making access difficult, contributing to its isolation.
